# Styling reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-references.mjs from lib/table.mjs. Do not edit. -->

Every element styles itself with a `style` attribute. These 45 properties are the
whole set. A property outside this list is refused by name, with the replacement named
when there is one.

Values are written in the canonical form, and a write reports every value it
rewrote. The short version: six or eight digit lower case hex, `px` lengths with zero
written `0`, `gap` and never `margin`, and longhand font properties.

## The properties

| Property | Accepted values |
|---|---|
| `display` | flex \| block \| none |
| `flex-direction` | row \| column |
| `flex-wrap` | wrap \| nowrap |
| `align-items` | flex-start \| center \| flex-end \| stretch \| baseline |
| `justify-content` | flex-start \| center \| flex-end \| space-between \| space-around |
| `gap` | 12px \| var(--space-md) |
| `padding` | 16px \| 16px 24px \| 16px 24px 8px 24px |
| `position` | absolute \| relative |
| `left` | -8px \| 0 \| var(--space-sm) |
| `top` | -8px \| 0 \| var(--space-sm) |
| `width` | 236px \| 100% \| 50% \| fit-content \| 100vh \| 100vw |
| `height` | 844px \| 100% \| 50% \| fit-content \| 100vh \| 100vw |
| `min-width` | 0 \| 200px |
| `max-width` | 480px \| 100% |
| `min-height` | 0 \| 44px |
| `max-height` | 100% \| 640px |
| `flex` | 1 1 0% \| 0 0 auto \| 1 1 auto |
| `flex-shrink` | 0 \| 1 |
| `align-self` | flex-start \| center \| flex-end \| stretch |
| `margin` | 0 \| -8px \| 16px 0 |
| `background-color` | #ffffff \| #ffffffee \| transparent \| var(--color-bg) |
| `border` | 1px solid #e5e7eb \| var(--border-hairline) |
| `border-width` | 1px \| 1px 0 1px 0 |
| `border-style` | solid \| dashed \| dotted |
| `border-color` | #e5e7eb \| var(--color-line) |
| `border-radius` | 12px \| 50% \| var(--radius-lg) |
| `box-shadow` | 0 6px 16px #0000001f \| 0 1px 2px #0000001a, 0 4px 8px #00000014 |
| `opacity` | 0 \| 0.5 \| 1 |
| `overflow` | hidden \| visible \| auto \| scroll |
| `outline` | 1px solid #b8325e |
| `outline-offset` | -2px \| 2px |
| `font-family` | Inter, system-ui, sans-serif \| var(--font-body) |
| `font-size` | 14px \| var(--size-body) |
| `font-weight` | 400 \| 500 \| 600 \| 700 \| bold |
| `font-style` | normal \| italic |
| `line-height` | 1.5 \| 20px |
| `letter-spacing` | 0.02em \| 1px |
| `color` | #111827 \| var(--color-ink) |
| `text-align` | left \| center \| right |
| `text-transform` | uppercase \| lowercase \| capitalize \| none |
| `white-space` | normal \| nowrap \| pre-wrap |
| `object-fit` | cover \| contain \| fill |
| `background-image` | url("photo.png") \| linear-gradient(180deg, #00000000, #000000b3) \| var(--img-hero) |
| `background-size` | cover \| contain \| auto \| 100% 100% |
| `background-position` | center \| top \| bottom \| left \| right |

## Value forms

| Property | Kind | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `display` | enum | One of: `flex`, `block`, `none`. |
| `flex-direction` | enum | One of: `row`, `column`. |
| `flex-wrap` | enum | One of: `wrap`, `nowrap`. |
| `align-items` | keyword-set | One of: `flex-start`, `center`, `flex-end`, `stretch`, `baseline`. |
| `justify-content` | keyword-set | One of: `flex-start`, `center`, `flex-end`, `space-between`, `space-around`. |
| `gap` | length | `px`, `%`, `em`, `rem`, `vh`, `vw`, or a keyword such as `auto` and `fit-content`. Zero is `0`. |
| `padding` | length | `px`, `%`, `em`, `rem`, `vh`, `vw`, or a keyword such as `auto` and `fit-content`. Zero is `0`. |
| `position` | enum | One of: `absolute`, `relative`. |
| `left` | length | `px`, `%`, `em`, `rem`, `vh`, `vw`, or a keyword such as `auto` and `fit-content`. Zero is `0`. |
| `top` | length | `px`, `%`, `em`, `rem`, `vh`, `vw`, or a keyword such as `auto` and `fit-content`. Zero is `0`. |
| `width` | length | `px`, `%`, `em`, `rem`, `vh`, `vw`, or a keyword such as `auto` and `fit-content`. Zero is `0`. |
| `height` | length | `px`, `%`, `em`, `rem`, `vh`, `vw`, or a keyword such as `auto` and `fit-content`. Zero is `0`. |
| `min-width` | length | `px`, `%`, `em`, `rem`, `vh`, `vw`, or a keyword such as `auto` and `fit-content`. Zero is `0`. |
| `max-width` | length | `px`, `%`, `em`, `rem`, `vh`, `vw`, or a keyword such as `auto` and `fit-content`. Zero is `0`. |
| `min-height` | length | `px`, `%`, `em`, `rem`, `vh`, `vw`, or a keyword such as `auto` and `fit-content`. Zero is `0`. |
| `max-height` | length | `px`, `%`, `em`, `rem`, `vh`, `vw`, or a keyword such as `auto` and `fit-content`. Zero is `0`. |
| `flex` | flex | `1 1 0%` fills the main axis. A bare number becomes `n 1 0%`. |
| `flex-shrink` | number | Between 0 and 10. |
| `align-self` | keyword-set | One of: `flex-start`, `center`, `flex-end`, `stretch`. |
| `margin` | length | `px`, `%`, `em`, `rem`, `vh`, `vw`, or a keyword such as `auto` and `fit-content`. Zero is `0`. |
| `background-color` | color | Six or eight digit hex, lower case. `transparent` is allowed. `rgb()` and `rgba()` are rewritten to hex. |
| `border` | border | Width, style, colour, in that order however they were written. |
| `border-width` | length | `px`, `%`, `em`, `rem`, `vh`, `vw`, or a keyword such as `auto` and `fit-content`. Zero is `0`. |
| `border-style` | keyword-set | One of: `solid`, `dashed`, `dotted`. |
| `border-color` | color | Six or eight digit hex, lower case. `transparent` is allowed. `rgb()` and `rgba()` are rewritten to hex. |
| `border-radius` | length | `px`, `%`, `em`, `rem`, `vh`, `vw`, or a keyword such as `auto` and `fit-content`. Zero is `0`. |
| `box-shadow` | shadow | `x y blur [spread] colour`, one or more separated by commas. Inner shadows are refused. |
| `opacity` | number | Between 0 and 1. |
| `overflow` | enum | One of: `hidden`, `visible`, `auto`, `scroll`. |
| `outline` | outline | — |
| `outline-offset` | length | `px`, `%`, `em`, `rem`, `vh`, `vw`, or a keyword such as `auto` and `fit-content`. Zero is `0`. |
| `font-family` | text | Taken as written. |
| `font-size` | length | `px`, `%`, `em`, `rem`, `vh`, `vw`, or a keyword such as `auto` and `fit-content`. Zero is `0`. |
| `font-weight` | font-weight | `400`, `500`, `600`, `700`. The words `normal`, `medium`, `semibold` and `bold` are rewritten to numbers. |
| `font-style` | enum | One of: `normal`, `italic`. |
| `line-height` | line-height | A ratio such as `1.5`, or a length. |
| `letter-spacing` | length | `px`, `%`, `em`, `rem`, `vh`, `vw`, or a keyword such as `auto` and `fit-content`. Zero is `0`. |
| `color` | color | Six or eight digit hex, lower case. `transparent` is allowed. `rgb()` and `rgba()` are rewritten to hex. |
| `text-align` | enum | One of: `left`, `center`, `right`. |
| `text-transform` | enum | One of: `uppercase`, `lowercase`, `capitalize`, `none`. |
| `white-space` | enum | One of: `normal`, `nowrap`, `pre-wrap`. |
| `object-fit` | enum | One of: `cover`, `contain`, `fill`. |
| `background-image` | image | `url("...")` or a `linear-gradient(...)`. The url argument is always quoted, so a `;` inside it cannot split the declaration. |
| `background-size` | keyword-set | One of: `cover`, `contain`, `auto`, `100% 100%`. |
| `background-position` | keyword-set | One of: `center`, `top`, `bottom`, `left`, `right`. |

## Aliases

An alias is accepted and rewritten. The file ends up holding the target.

| Written | Becomes |
|---|---|
| `background` | `background-color` |
| `background-colour` | `background-color` |
| `bg-color` | `background-color` |

## Refused properties

Each one is refused with the reason below, so a refusal tells you what to write
instead.

| Property | Reason | Write instead |
|---|---|---|
| `animation` | No animation. A design file is a still. | — |
| `border-bottom` | Use border-width with four values for one edge. | `border-width: 0 0 1px 0` |
| `border-left` | Use border-width with four values for one edge. | `border-width: 0 0 0 1px` |
| `border-right` | Use border-width with four values for one edge. | `border-width: 0 1px 0 0` |
| `border-top` | Use border-width with four values for one edge. | `border-width: 1px 0 0 0` |
| `cursor` | The format describes appearance, not interaction. A cursor is behavior. | — |
| `font` | Write the longhand properties. | `font-family, font-size, font-weight and line-height` |
| `grid-gap` | The property is named gap. | `gap` |
| `grid-template-columns` | The format has no grid. Flex covers the same layouts. | `display:flex with flex:1 on the children` |
| `grid-template-rows` | The format has no grid. Flex covers the same layouts. | `display:flex with flex:1 on the children` |
| `margin-bottom` | Write the shorthand: margin: 0 0 8px 0. | `gap on the parent, or margin on this element` |
| `margin-left` | Write the shorthand: margin: 0 0 0 8px. | `gap on the parent, or margin on this element` |
| `margin-right` | Write the shorthand: margin: 0 8px 0 0. | `gap on the parent, or margin on this element` |
| `margin-top` | A one-sided margin is a second spelling of the same intent. | `margin with four values` |
| `rotate` | No transforms. | — |
| `text-decoration` | Not in the format. Use a border-width on the bottom edge for an underline. | — |
| `transform` | No transforms. Position the element with left and top instead. | — |
| `transition` | No animation. A design file is a still. | — |
| `z-index` | Paint order follows document order. Move the element instead. | `document order` |

## Custom properties

A declaration whose name starts with `--` is always accepted. That is how a design
carries a local value without a token for it.

## Tokens

Tokens are declared once, in the `<head>`:

```html
<style>:root{ --color-bg:#0b0d12; --space-md:16px }</style>
```

The group is the text before the first hyphen, and it must be one of: `color`, `font`, `space`, `radius`, `size`, `shadow`, `border`.

| Group | Unit a number carries |
|---|---|
| `color` | none (a colour, a font stack, a shadow) |
| `font` | none (a colour, a font stack, a shadow) |
| `space` | px |
| `radius` | px |
| `size` | px |
| `shadow` | none (a colour, a font stack, a shadow) |
| `border` | none (a colour, a font stack, a shadow) |

Reference a token with `var(--name)`. `export --resolve-tokens` bakes the values in
instead, so the deliverable needs no token block.
